title: A customer made from New Work Order starts on Default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, so the client has more than one active tier.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders.
  2. Click New Work Order.
  3. Create a new customer from the dialog's customer field, with a name no other customer uses.
  4. Finish creating the work order.
  5. Open the new customer's page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Work Orders list shows.

Step 2:

  • The New Work Order dialog opens.

Step 3:

  • The customer is created and picked in the dialog.

Step 4:

  • The work order opens for the new customer.

Step 5:

  • The card shows Work Order Tier and Part Sales Tier as 1 · Default.
